email.body1:
K.C., saw Dealerslink launch the 2026 AI Suite and set a booth record with 1,400+ dealers at NADA.

That kind of interest usually surfaces more in-market dealers than a regional team can personally reach before the quarter closes. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Dealerslink off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
K.C., quick follow-up for Dealerslink.

A record show floor creates a wave of warm dealers, but most teams can't tell how many of those turn into booked meetings before the trail goes cold. The gap surfaces late, and by then the quarter is a scramble rather than a plan.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
K.C., last bit of proof for Dealerslink.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your region's reply rate likely compares to peer automotive software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
K.C., I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling dealer coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Post-NADA is busy, and timing matters more than any pitch.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of 3 AI-SDR plays scoped to a regional dealer motion? I'll tailor it to Dealerslink either way.
